# Mass Fabricator
While working on the Planetary Shield Generator, an engineer at Horizon decided to build a prototype upgrade to the RCD building on the hardlight technology being used for the shields.
While the concept never actually made it to mass production, prototypes and schematics for the item are still within the sector.
[color=gray][italic]The working engineers apparently used the chassis of some other handheld device as a stopgap.[/italic][/color]
The HZ Mass Fabricator is, at it's core, a sidegrade to the RCD that allows for planning builds on planets and grids and quickly fabricating them instead of manual placement. This comes at the cost of [bold]lacking support for compressed matter[/bold].
## Usage
The Fabricator comes with a headset that allows remotely viewing an area around you and selecting blueprints to plan in a location. [color=gray][italic](In more practical terms, just activate the gun to swap to the planning mode.)[/italic][/color]
While in the Plan mode, you are effectively put into an AI camera until you exit by hitting ESC. Right-clicking will open a radial menu that allows you to select from 3 primary subcategories:
- Tiling, which allows placing tiles. - Bulkheads, which allows placing entities such as walls or stairs. - Erase, which removes unprinted plans.
Once you choose a blueprint from a category, placement works identically to when preparing a schematic for a ship, albeit instead of directly placing an object it creates a visible plan of that object.
Exiting the planning mode allows you to start printing any plan, assuming you have the required materials. For tiles specifically, build plans for the same tile adjacent automatically flood outwards.
## Aquiring
[bold]This piece of equipment is not as of yet publically available to members of the Colossus sector.[/bold]
